///////////////////////////////
marker $$ test *COPY 0 1 $.biged $$
///////////////////////////////

; --------------------------------------------------
; load fujinet rom
memory load rom #0x8000 "${WS_ROOT}/build/fujinet.rom"
symbols load "${WS_ROOT}/build/fujinet.rom.lbl"

; load in the harness which sets up MOS stubs, and various vectors
memory load atari "${BINARY_PATH}"
symbols load "${SYMBOLS_PATH}"

; remove any cc65 autogenerated symbols from the ROM
symbols remove "__.*"

; mark the ROM as read only
memory protect ro #0xFF00 0x0100

; clean start
registers flush

; initialise the ROM
run $init_harness until (CP = $end_init_harness OR cycle_count > 5000)
assert CP = $end_init_harness $$completed code correctly$$
assert cycle_count <= 2000    $$cycles within accpeptable limit from previous runs$$
; --------------------------------------------------

; Drive 1 destination catalogue (from copy_test.log reads 018/019).
; TODO: need dump files for this without the SLIP framing
memory load #0x0E08 "${UNIT_TEST_DIR}/data/copy/dest_cat_s0.bin"
memory load #0x0F00 "${UNIT_TEST_DIR}/data/copy/dest_cat_s1.bin"
memory write #0x0F05 0x(40)

memory write $fuji_drive_disk_map 0x(00,01,FF,FF)
memory write $fuji_state 0x(C0)
memory write $fuji_disk_slot 0x(01)

; Source file $.biged attributes (Y=64 row on drive 0 catalogue).
memory write #0x0C5 0x(62,69,67,65,64,20,20,24)
memory write #0x0BB 0x(0f,00,00,00,00,aa,00,00)

memory write $current_drv 0x(01)

registers set cycle_count=0
run $load_and_execute_addr_hi2 until (cycle_count > 2000)
run $create_file_2 until (cycle_count > 0xF000)

assert #0x0E08 ~ "FUJI" $$destination catalogue loaded$$
assert #0x0F05 = 72 $$nine catalogue rows (was 64)$$

; Ninth row (Y=64): sector must be $202 after $.FUJI, not $042 after $.DFS226.
assert #0x0F4F = 0x02 $$start sector low byte of $202$$
assert #0x0F4F != 0x42 $$must not use last catalogue row extent $042$$
assert #0x0E48 ~ "biged" $$filename intact in new catalogue row$$
assert #0x0E49 = 0x69 $$seed must not clobber pws_tmp06/07 (C6/C7) in filename$$
